title: Microsoft Purview: Classifier Simulation Mode for custom classifiers
summary: The briefing passes: the planned behaviour, default availability and rollout windows agree with Microsoft's supplied notice and roadmap. The existing custom SIT paths and PowerShell calls are documented, and the briefing distinguishes them from the new simulation capability without inventing licensing or operational details.
